note: [L] gets the truncation as an eventual-in-d property, uniform on the compact set through `Meadow.cashier`, instead of a finite cover and a largest index, and puts the localization errors into abstract `turnFee*g + g` terms instead of the 12/16 share.

snippet.text:
lemma topped (hv:IsCompact s) : ∀ᶠ d in atTop, (∀ x∈s, ∀ i:Site A₀,(B).supBounds i (neighbors e i) (beacons H he W d x i) (gleam (A:=A) (C:=C) (m:=m))) ∧ ∀ x∈s,
    Meadow.Budget B H.doors.reg (uptick H d x|>.logRead) (((1/16+2*(1/16:ℝ))*forecastE A.B.a m + turnFee B*g) + g):=(shoePay h hm H he hh hx ht W).and (above h hm H hc he hh hv)

proof_context.conclusion: `topped`: eventually in the truncation index `d`, uniformly for x in a compact interval, the localization bounds `supBounds` with `gleam` hold and the regular budget is `(1/16+2*(1/16))*forecastE + turnFee*g + g`.

lemma above (hv:IsCompact s) : ∀ᶠ d:ℕ in atTop,∀ x∈s,
    Meadow.Budget B H.doors.reg (uptick H d x|>.logRead) (((1/16+2*(1/16:ℝ))*forecastE A.B.a m + turnFee B*g) + g):= by
  have hG : 0<(g):= by rw [gold, ← PriceCompiler.beta_eq A.B.valid]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans (A.B.a.fits.delayed _)) _
  have he':= Meadow.cashier (Z:=posting B H.base) (H:=H.doors) (fun i=>(Beam.rewrite_rule H.base (B) i).symm) (B) (Meadow.debris H.base) hv (Meadow.dissolved H.base) (Yearling.hearthcast h.conducts H he hc hh.year h.range hm) (fun x hy=> ⟨_,_,twined h hm H he hh x⟩) g hG

proof_context.conclusion: `above` proves the regular budget eventually in `d` on the compact set `s`, the uniformity coming from the compactness lemma `Meadow.cashier`.

snippet.text: lemma shoePay : ∀ᶠ d:ℕ in atTop,∀ x∈s,∀ i:Site A₀,(B).supBounds i (neighbors e i) (beacons H he W d x i) (gleam (A:=A) (C:=C) (m:=m)):= by

proof_context.conclusion: `shoePay`: eventually in `d`, the localization sup-bounds `gleam` hold for every x in `s`.
